sentences.en: "Are they all dead?" my wife asked.

sentences.en: We ran down the hill to our house.

sentences.en: I knew then that guns could not stop the Martians, and that the Martians had come to kill us all.

sentences.en: "I will come back soon," I said, "and I will not go near the machine."

sentences.en: I kissed her, turned the horse, and drove out into the dark.

sentences.en: Far away in the sky I saw a light that came and went.

sentences.tgt: Je:o montai:v dans:o la:o barque:n et:o m':o écartai:v de:o la:o rive:n .:o

sentences.en: The river was quiet, and the water was cold.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fleuve:n était:v calme:a ,:o et:o l':o eau:n était:v froide:a .:o

sentences.en: Near Shepperton I saw soldiers behind a wall, and they had guns.
sentences.tgt: Près:a de:o Shepperton:o ,:o j':o aperçus:v des:o soldats:n postés:a derrière:o un:o mur:n ,:o et:o ils:o avaient:v des:o canons:n .:o

sentences.en: They were waiting and looking at the river.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o attendaient:v ,:o les:o yeux:n fixés:a sur:o le:o fleuve:n .:o

sentences.en: "Get down!" a soldier called to me.

sentences.en: "They are coming!"
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o voilà:o !:o »:o

sentences.en: I lay down in the boat and looked over the edge.
sentences.tgt: Je:o m':o allongeai:v au:o fond:n de:o la:o barque:n et:o regardai:v par-dessus:o le:o bord:n .:o

sentences.en: Then three machines came down the river, and the water came up to their legs.
sentences.tgt: Alors:a trois:o machines:n descendirent:v le:o fleuve:n ,:o et:o l':o eau:n baignait:v leurs:o jambes:n .:o

sentences.en: The soldiers shot at them, and the noise was very loud.
sentences.tgt: Les:o soldats:n ouvrirent:v le:o feu:n ,:o et:o le:o vacarme:n fut:v assourdissant:a .:o

sentences.en: A shot hit the hood of one machine, and the machine fell into the river.
sentences.tgt: Un:o obus:n atteignit:v le:o capuchon:n d':o une:o des:o machines:n ,:o qui:o s':o abattit:v dans:o le:o fleuve:n .:o

sentences.en: It made a great noise in the water, and steam went up.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o heurta:v l':o eau:n dans:o un:o grand:a fracas:n ,:o et:o de:o la:o vapeur:n s':o éleva:v .:o

sentences.en: A cry came from it, and the cry was not the cry of a person.
sentences.tgt: Un:o cri:n en:o sortit:v ,:o un:o cri:n qui:o n':o avait:v rien:o d':o humain:a .:o

sentences.en: "Ulla, ulla," the Martian cried, and it cried again and again.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ulla:o ,:o ulla:o ,:o »:o hurlait:v le:o Martien:n ,:o encore:a et:o encore:a .:o

sentences.en: The other two machines turned toward the soldiers, and the hoods shone.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o autres:a machines:n se:o tournèrent:v vers:o les:o soldats:n ,:o et:o leurs:o capuchons:n étincelèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: The light went over the river, and the water became steam.
sentences.tgt: La:o lumière:n balaya:v le:o fleuve:n ,:o et:o l':o eau:n se:o changea:v en:o vapeur:n .:o

sentences.en: The steam was hot, and it burned my hands and my face.
sentences.tgt: La:o vapeur:n était:v brûlante:a ,:o et:o elle:o me:o brûla:v les:o mains:n et:o le:o visage:n .:o

sentences.en: I could not see, and I could not breathe.
sentences.tgt: Je:o n':o y:o voyais:v rien:o ,:o et:o je:o ne:o pouvais:v plus:o respirer:v .:o

sentences.en: I fell out of the boat, and the boat went over.
sentences.tgt: Je:o tombai:v de:o la:o barque:n ,:o qui:o chavira:v .:o

sentences.en: I swam to the bank and ran through the steam.
sentences.tgt: Je:o nageai:v jusqu':o à:o la:o rive:n et:o courus:v à:o travers:o la:o vapeur:n .:o

sentences.en: When the steam went up, the soldiers were dead, and the wall was on fire.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o la:o vapeur:n se:o dissipa:v ,:o les:o soldats:n étaient:v morts:a ,:o et:o le:o mur:n était:v en:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: The two machines walked on toward Shepperton, and they did not look at me.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o machines:n poursuivirent:v leur:o marche:n vers:o Shepperton:o ,:o sans:o un:o regard:n pour:o moi:o .:o

sentences.en: The Martian in the river did not move again, and I did not stay to see it.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Martien:n tombé:v dans:o le:o fleuve:n ne:o bougea:v plus:o ,:o et:o je:o ne:o restai:v pas:o pour:o le:o regarder:v .:o

sentences.en: I ran away from the river until I came to a field, and I lay down in the grass.
sentences.tgt: Je:o m':o éloignai:v du:o fleuve:n en:o courant:v jusqu':o à:o un:o champ:n ,:o et:o je:o m':o allongeai:v dans:o l':o herbe:n .:o

sentences.en: I did not know if anyone else was alive.
sentences.tgt: Je:o ne:o savais:v pas:o si:o quelqu'un:o d':o autre:o avait:v survécu:v .:o

sentences.en: I lay in the field until it was dark, and then I got up.
sentences.tgt: Je:o restai:v couché:a dans:o le:o champ:n jusqu':o à:o la:o nuit:n ,:o puis:a je:o me:o levai:v .:o

sentences.en: Halliford was near, and I walked toward it along the river.
sentences.tgt: Halliford:o n':o était:v pas:o loin:a ,:o et:o je:o m':o y:o dirigeai:v en:o longeant:v le:o fleuve:n .:o

sentences.en: The houses were empty, and there were no lights in them.
sentences.tgt: Les:o maisons:n étaient:v vides:a ,:o et:o aucune:o fenêtre:n n':o était:v éclairée:a .:o

sentences.en: In a garden I saw a man sitting on the ground, dressed in black.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o un:o jardin:n ,:o je:o vis:v un:o homme:n vêtu:a de:o noir:n ,:o assis:a par:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: He looked at me, and I looked at him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o me:o regarda:v ,:o et:o je:o le:o regardai:v .:o

sentences.en: "Who are you?" I asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qui:o êtes:v -vous:o ?:o »:o demandai:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "I am a curate," he said, "and my church is on fire."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o suis:v vicaire:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o ,:o «:o et:o mon:o église:n est:v en:o flammes:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "What has happened to us?" the curate said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Que:o nous:o arrive:v -t-il:o ?:o »:o dit:v le:o vicaire:n .:o

sentences.en: "What have we done?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Qu':o avons:v -nous:o fait:v ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "Why is God so angry with us?"
sentences.tgt: «:o Pourquoi:a Dieu:o nous:o en:o veut:v -il:o à:o ce:o point:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: "It is not God who did this," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o n':o est:v pas:o Dieu:o qui:o a:v fait:v cela:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "It is the Martians."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o sont:v les:o Martiens:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It is the end of the world," the curate said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v la:o fin:n du:o monde:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o vicaire:n .:o

sentences.en: "They will kill us all."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ils:o vont:v nous:o tuer:v jusqu':o au:o dernier:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "They will not kill us all," I said, "for they cannot be everywhere."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ils:o ne:o nous:o tueront:v pas:o tous:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o ,:o «:o car:o ils:o ne:o peuvent:v pas:o être:v partout:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Be quiet, for we must find food, and we must hide."
sentences.tgt: «:o Taisez:v -vous:o ,:o car:o il:o faut:v trouver:v de:o quoi:o manger:v ,:o et:o nous:o cacher:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "I am afraid," the curate said.
sentences.tgt: «:o J':o ai:v peur:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o vicaire:n .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know what to do."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o sais:v pas:o quoi:o faire:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Then come with me," I said, "and do what I say."
sentences.tgt: «:o Alors:a venez:v avec:o moi:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o ,:o «:o et:o faites:v ce:o que:o je:o vous:o dis:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: We went into a house near the river, where the door was open.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o entrâmes:v dans:o une:o maison:n au:o bord:n du:o fleuve:n ,:o dont:o la:o porte:n était:v ouverte:a .:o

sentences.en: In the kitchen I found some bread and a bottle of wine.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o la:o cuisine:n ,:o je:o trouvai:v du:o pain:n et:o une:o bouteille:n de:o vin:n .:o

sentences.en: The curate ate fast and did not stop, and he did not look at me.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vicaire:n mangea:v gloutonnement:a ,:o sans:o s':o arrêter:v et:o sans:o lever:v les:o yeux:n vers:o moi:o .:o

sentences.en: I gave him the wine, and he drank it all.
sentences.tgt: Je:o lui:o tendis:v le:o vin:n ,:o et:o il:o but:v toute:o la:o bouteille:n .:o

sentences.en: He sat down on the floor and began to cry.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o assit:v par:o terre:n et:o se:o mit:v à:o pleurer:v .:o

sentences.en: "Be a man," I said, "for the Martians will hear you."
sentences.tgt: «:o Soyez:v un:o homme:n ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o ,:o «:o car:o les:o Martiens:n vont:v vous:o entendre:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Where is your wife?" the curate asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:o est:v votre:o femme:n ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o vicaire:n .:o

sentences.en: "My wife is in Leatherhead," I said, "and I must go to her."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ma:o femme:n est:v à:o Leatherhead:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o ,:o «:o et:o je:o dois:v la:o rejoindre:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Then I will go with you," the curate said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Alors:a je:o vous:o accompagne:v ,:o »:o dit:v le:o vicaire:n .:o

sentences.en: I did not want him with me, but I did not say no.
sentences.tgt: Je:o ne:o tenais:v pas:o à:o l':o emmener:v ,:o mais:o je:o ne:o dis:v pas:o non:o .:o

sentences.en: The curate slept on the floor, and I sat by the window.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vicaire:n dormit:v par:o terre:n ,:o et:o je:o m':o assis:v près:a de:o la:o fenêtre:n .:o

sentences.en: The sky was red toward Weybridge, and I heard guns far away.
sentences.tgt: Le:o ciel:n était:v rouge:a du:o côté:n de:o Weybridge:o ,:o et:o j':o entendais:v le:o canon:n au:o loin:a .:o

sentences.en: I thought of my wife in Leatherhead, and I could not sleep.
sentences.tgt: Je:o pensais:v à:o ma:o femme:n ,:o à:o Leatherhead:o ,:o et:o je:o ne:o pus:v fermer:v l':o œil:n .:o

sentences.en: Before it was light, I woke the curate, and we went out.
sentences.tgt: Avant:o l':o aube:n ,:o je:o réveillai:v le:o vicaire:n ,:o et:o nous:o sortîmes:v .:o

sentences.en: The curate and I walked along the river in the dark.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vicaire:n et:o moi:o longeâmes:v le:o fleuve:n dans:o l':o obscurité:n .:o

sentences.en: When it was light, we came to a hill and looked down at Weybridge.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o il:o fit:v jour:n ,:o nous:o atteignîmes:v une:o colline:n et:o regardâmes:v Weybridge:o en:o contrebas:a .:o

sentences.en: Most of the houses were gone.
sentences.tgt: La:o plupart:n des:o maisons:n avaient:v disparu:v .:o

sentences.en: Smoke went up from the ruins.
sentences.tgt: De:o la:o fumée:n s':o élevait:v des:o décombres:n .:o

sentences.en: Three machines stood in the town, and they did not move.
sentences.tgt: Trois:o machines:n se:o dressaient:v dans:o la:o ville:n ,:o et:o elles:o ne:o bougeaient:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: No bird flew over the town, and it was very quiet.
sentences.tgt: Aucun:o oiseau:n ne:o survolait:v la:o ville:n ,:o et:o il:o régnait:v un:o grand:a silence:n .:o

sentences.en: The sun shone on the hoods, and they were bright.
sentences.tgt: Le:o soleil:n brillait:v sur:o les:o capuchons:n ,:o qui:o étincelaient:v .:o

sentences.en: "Get down!" I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Couchez:v -vous:o !:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "They will see us."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ils:o vont:v nous:o voir:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: We lay in the grass and watched the town.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o nous:o couchâmes:v dans:o l':o herbe:n et:o observâmes:v la:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: Some soldiers came along the road with a gun.
sentences.tgt: Quelques:o soldats:n arrivèrent:v par:o la:o route:n avec:o un:o canon:n .:o

sentences.en: They did not know that the machines were near.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o ne:o savaient:v pas:o que:o les:o machines:n étaient:v si:a près:a .:o

sentences.en: One machine turned, and I saw it lift a tube in the air.
sentences.tgt: Une:o des:o machines:n se:o tourna:v ,:o et:o je:o la:o vis:v lever:v un:o tube:n en:o l':o air:n .:o

sentences.en: "What is it doing?" the curate asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Qu':o est:v -ce:o qu':o elle:o fait:v ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o vicaire:n .:o

sentences.en: "I do not know," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o ne:o sais:v pas:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: There was a loud noise, and something flew through the air and fell near the soldiers.
sentences.tgt: Il:o y:o eut:v une:o détonation:n ,:o et:o quelque:o chose:n fendit:v l':o air:n pour:o retomber:v près:a des:o soldats:n .:o

sentences.en: It broke on the ground, and black smoke came out of it.
sentences.tgt: Cela:o se:o brisa:v sur:o le:o sol:n ,:o et:o une:o fumée:n noire:a s':o en:o échappa:v .:o

sentences.en: The smoke was heavy, and it did not go up.
sentences.tgt: La:o fumée:n était:v lourde:a ,:o et:o elle:o ne:o montait:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: It lay on the ground and rolled over the road.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o restait:v au:o ras:n du:o sol:n et:o déferlait:v sur:o la:o route:n .:o

sentences.en: The soldiers ran.
sentences.tgt: Les:o soldats:n s':o enfuirent:v .:o

sentences.en: The smoke was faster than the soldiers, and they fell down one by one.
sentences.tgt: La:o fumée:n allait:v plus:a vite:a qu':o eux:o ,:o et:o ils:o tombèrent:v un:o à:o un:o .:o

sentences.en: The horses fell too, and none of them got up.
sentences.tgt: Les:o chevaux:n tombèrent:v aussi:a ,:o et:o aucun:o ne:o se:o releva:v .:o

sentences.en: "It is a poison," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v du:o poison:n ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "It kills anyone who breathes it."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o tue:v quiconque:o le:o respire:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "It is the judgment of God," the curate said, and he began to cry again.
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v le:o jugement:n de:o Dieu:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o vicaire:n ,:o et:o il:o se:o remit:v à:o pleurer:v .:o

sentences.en: "It is not God," I said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ce:o n':o est:v pas:o Dieu:o ,:o »:o dis:v -je:o .:o

sentences.en: "It is a gas, and the Martians made it."
sentences.tgt: «:o C':o est:v un:o gaz:n ,:o et:o ce:o sont:v les:o Martiens:n qui:o l':o ont:v fabriqué:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: A machine came down the road and sent out a cloud of white steam.
sentences.tgt: Une:o machine:n descendit:v la:o route:n en:o crachant:v un:o nuage:n de:o vapeur:n blanche:a .:o

sentences.en: The steam went over the black smoke, and the smoke was gone.
sentences.tgt: La:o vapeur:n recouvrit:v la:o fumée:n noire:a ,:o et:o celle-ci:o se:o dissipa:v .:o

sentences.en: Only the dead lay in the road, and the machines stood over them.
sentences.tgt: Seuls:a les:o morts:n gisaient:v sur:o la:o route:n ,:o et:o les:o machines:n les:o dominaient:v .:o

sentences.en: I took the curate by the arm, and we crept away from the hill.
sentences.tgt: Je:o pris:v le:o vicaire:n par:o le:o bras:n ,:o et:o nous:o quittâmes:v la:o colline:n en:o rampant:v .:o

sentences.en: We walked on until night, and we did not speak.
sentences.tgt: Nous:o marchâmes:v jusqu':o à:o la:o nuit:n ,:o sans:o échanger:v un:o mot:n .:o

sentences.en: My brother lived in London, where he was learning to be a doctor.

sentences.en: The paper said that the soldiers would kill the Martians soon.
sentences.tgt: Selon:o le:o journal:n ,:o les:o soldats:n viendraient:v bientôt:a à:o bout:n des:o Martiens:n .:o

sentences.en: My brother believed it.
sentences.tgt: Mon:o frère:n le:o crut:v .:o

sentences.en: London was quiet that day, and people walked in the streets and talked about the Martians.
sentences.tgt: Londres:o était:v calme:a ce:o jour:n -là:o ,:o et:o les:o gens:n se:o promenaient:v dans:o les:o rues:n en:o parlant:v des:o Martiens:n .:o

sentences.en: No one was afraid, for no one knew about the machines.
sentences.tgt: Personne:o n':o avait:v peur:n ,:o car:o personne:o n':o avait:v entendu:v parler:v des:o machines:n .:o

sentences.en: On Monday morning the paper told a different story.
sentences.tgt: Le:o lundi:n matin:n ,:o le:o journal:n tenait:v un:o tout:a autre:a langage:n .:o

sentences.en: "The Martians have killed the soldiers at Weybridge and Shepperton," it said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o Martiens:n ont:v tué:v les:o soldats:n à:o Weybridge:o et:o à:o Shepperton:o ,:o »:o disait:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: "They have machines that walk, and a black smoke that kills."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ils:o ont:v des:o machines:n qui:o marchent:v ,:o et:o une:o fumée:n noire:a qui:o tue:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "They are coming to London, and everyone must go."
sentences.tgt: «:o Ils:o marchent:v sur:o Londres:o ,:o et:o tout:o le:o monde:n doit:v partir:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: My brother put down the paper and looked out of his window.
sentences.tgt: Mon:o frère:n posa:v le:o journal:n et:o regarda:v par:o la:o fenêtre:n .:o

sentences.en: The street was full of people, and they all carried bags.
sentences.tgt: La:o rue:n était:v noire:a de:o monde:n ,:o et:o chacun:o portait:v des:o bagages:n .:o

sentences.en: Carts and horses went by, and there was a great noise.
sentences.tgt: Charrettes:n et:o chevaux:n défilaient:v dans:o un:o vacarme:n épouvantable:a .:o

sentences.en: "Where are you going?" my brother asked a man.
sentences.tgt: «:o Où:o allez:v -vous:o ?:o »:o demanda:v mon:o frère:n à:o un:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "I am going north," the man said, "for the Martians are coming."
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o pars:v vers:o le:o nord:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o homme:n ,:o «:o car:o les:o Martiens:n arrivent:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Will there be a train?" my brother asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Y:o aura:v -t-il:o un:o train:n ?:o »:o demanda:v mon:o frère:n .:o

sentences.en: "There will be no train," the man said, "for the stations are full."
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o n':o y:o aura:v pas:o de:o train:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o homme:n ,:o «:o car:o les:o gares:n sont:v bondées:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: My brother went to a station and saw that it was true.
sentences.tgt: Mon:o frère:n se:o rendit:v dans:o une:o gare:n et:o constata:v que:o c':o était:v vrai:a .:o

sentences.en: A great crowd stood there, pushing and shouting.
sentences.tgt: Une:o foule:n énorme:a s':o y:o bousculait:v en:o criant:v .:o

sentences.en: No train came, and some of the people began to fight.
sentences.tgt: Aucun:o train:n n':o arriva:v ,:o et:o certains:o en:o vinrent:v aux:o mains:n .:o

sentences.en: "I will not stay here," my brother said to himself.
